Directorate of Health Services, Campal Panaji - Goa

WALK IN INTERVIEW 

The Director, Directorate of Health Services, Campal, Panaji-Goa, desires to make the following appointments purely on Contract Basis as here above:

RANKASH ART ACADEMY

🎨 WE ARE HIRING! – 2 STAFF

📌 Qualification:

Graduation / Diploma in Pre-Primary Teacher Education (DPPTE) / D.Ed
Any one of the above qualifications
🎯 What We Are Looking For:

Passionate about art & drawing with creative skills
Caring and patient with young children
Good communication skills
Basic computer knowledge is required
Candidate should be from nearby areas to Ponda
🕒 Job Timing: 3:30 PM to 8:30 PM

💰 Salary: ₹10,000 – ₹13,000 per month

📲 How to Apply: Send your CV via WhatsApp to 9022531718

📅 Last Date to Apply: 12 October 2026

📍 Location: Rankash Art Academy, 2nd Floor, Shri Krishna Jaganath Kamat Tower Building, Behind Old Bus Stand, Ponda, Goa.
Application are invited for the following post.
